entities.summary: Anthony DeAngelo is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the New York Islanders of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has also played with the Arizona Coyotes, New York Rangers, Carolina Hurricanes, and Philadelphia Flyers as well as SKA Saint Petersburg in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
